rules.rule: npm run check's 'npx tsc --noEmit' type-checks zero files (root tsconfig files:[] + references, no -b). Until TM-B04 is done, a green check is not type-safety evidence.
E2E acceptance is run with --retries=0; playwright.config.ts retries:1 hides flakes.
On the GitHub runner Electron needs --no-sandbox (SUID sandbox helper not root/4755, apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1). Any C real-app launch passes it.

Clean-checkout simulation = rm -rf out test-results playwright-report tests/fixtures/*.wav, then the command; agents never run git clean -xfd or npm ci. Real npm ci evidence comes from the Actions run.
Independent readers: music-metadata decodes LIST/INFO as latin1 (Georgian UTF-8 becomes mojibake); for non-ASCII values compare against ffprobe and raw INFO bytes, and record which reader was used.
WAV fixtures used for writes must have a non-empty data chunk (node-taglib-sharp 6.0.1 cannot parse a data chunk that ends exactly at EOF with size 0, see TM-B05).

Saba froze only package.json version + build (electron-builder config); B freezes the whole package.json per round unless a task lists scripts as owned. src/preload/* frozen unless a round says otherwise.
Until root links a green Actions run, TM-T0-CI and TM-T0 stay in_progress (realVerified=false).
C red proofs that need a source edit are done in a /tmp copy of the repo (node_modules symlinked), never in the working tree.

decisions.status: user-stated, open alternatives listed by user
decisions.decision: Recording category = fixed standard field key 'category' -> RIFF LIST/INFO 'ICAT' (not IGNR, not iXML USER/CATID, not ISBJ). Not in STANDARD_PROP_MAP; written via InfoTag path like keywords.
Keywords = standard field 'keywords' -> LIST/INFO 'IKEY', one string, separators ',' or ';'.
Description = standard field 'comment' -> LIST/INFO 'ICMT' (the ID3 COMM copy is incidental; importer ignores it).
INFO values are written UTF-8 by node-taglib-sharp; importer reads LIST/INFO itself (UTF-8 fatal -> latin1 fallback) and does not use ffprobe format_tags (multi-value loss, bext->comment, encoding).

'WAV file is missing data chunk' in E2E: fixture is fixed (non-empty data). Root cause is node-taglib-sharp 6.0.1 riffFile.read() loop 'position + 8 < length' skipping an empty data chunk at EOF; tracked as TM-B05, dependency not patched.
Existing schema.json is NOT auto-migrated to include 'category'; it appears under disabled standard fields; README/doc note.
Empty category is allowed (not every file is SFX).
check.yml lives in the Tag Manager repo; loop memory in a separate repo.

Empty-value policy for INFO fields: today an empty Keywords field is written as IKEY="" (size 0) and ffprobe shows "IKEY": "" (C-R1-01). Options: skip empty INFO chunks vs write and document. B default proposal: skip empty (importer treats absent = empty). Decide before/with T-1.

Type-check gate = tsc --noEmit -p for each of tsconfig.node/web/test.json (scripts.typecheck, called from scripts.check). skipLibCheck:true (node_modules type conflicts are not ours); target ES2022 (src has no classes, so the useDefineForClassFields default change has no runtime effect); src/preload/index.d.ts added to web/test include without changing it. Root tsconfig.json stays unchanged (tsconfig.test.json is not composite; a reference would raise TS6306).
